item.title: October Lantern 0.6.16
item.description:
Show me

  • Ask Lantern how to do something on your computer, then click Show me on screen (or Show me in Point & Ask). Lantern draws an orange ring with an arrow around the place to click, one step at a time.
  • The ring stays until you click it, then Lantern looks again and shows the next step. If you open or switch windows, it looks again on its own.
  • Each look sends a picture of your screen to October. Lantern never clicks or types for you.
  • On Mac, Windows and Linux (X11). On Wayland, Lantern marks the step on a picture of your screen instead.

Cards for your agents

  • Questions, hand-offs, progress and results from your agents show up as cards you can answer with a click.
  • Ask Lantern can send work to an agent that's already running.

Your own AI key, Lantern Lifetime and the Pro trial

  • Use your own AI key for Ask Lantern, or get Lantern Lifetime or try Pro free.
  • Free accounts get 5 Ask Lantern questions a day.

Also

  • Tasks no longer get stuck on "Getting started" when your terminal asks a question at startup (like oh-my-zsh's update prompt).
  • Agents Lantern starts with app access work in front of you, not hidden in the background, unless you ask.
  • Send Logs now says what happened to each Ask Lantern task, so we can fix problems faster.
  • Lantern recovers more safely if its engine stops unexpectedly.

The Windows installer isn't code-signed yet: if Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click More info, then Run anyway.
